page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a numbered list of short paragraphs in the column. No margin notes. Page number and running head at the top. Catchword at the lower right. Faint signature at the foot.

main_text.p: x A fine seu Usu hujus doctrinæ, qui triplex ostendatur.
1. Vt veritas promissionum divinarum de salute electorum stabiliatur.
2. Vt efficacia intercessionis Christi sit salva.
3. Vt consolatio piorum in lapsib. contra desperationem confirmet.
x 1. Sit amplificatio prioris ab incommodis doctrinæ contrariæ de fluxa sanctorum fide & dubia electorum salute:
4. Amorem Dei & Deum ipsum facit mutabilem.
6. Denique promissiones omnes de certa electorum salute in dubium vocat.

Conclusio sit hortatio, ut scrutetur Scripturam, & ex ea potius, quam ex calumniis adversariorum hanc doctrinam æstimet: Et pollicitatio uberioris declarationis, si quid vel non satis assequatur, vel ad objecta sibi responderi velit.

page.notes: The Greek word after "Stabilit" is faint; read as ἐπιχλῳ with doubt. "lucta" is uncertain, possibly "luctis" or a similar form. The signature "N j" at the foot is faint and uncertain. Show-through from the facing page is ignored. The "x" marks before the first paragraph and before "1." are read as printed.
